article.title: 'Family in the Woods' to be reunited
article.summary:
(ANSA) - ROME, SEP 1 - A L'Aquila children's court on Tuesday ruled that the 'Family in the Woods' parents could be reunited with their three children after the minors were stripped from them last year because of their allegedly detrimental off-the-grid lifestyle in an Abruzzo forest.
The court said the kids could now return to their Australian mother Catherine Birmingham and British father Nathan Trevallion.
However, the process must be gradual, in stages and under strict supervision by social services, the court ruled.
The couple have been fighting to get their kids back since last November.
At the end of April the same court court in L'Aquila ruled that the couple's appeal against a juvenile court's decision to eject the mother from the foster home where their three children have been living since November was inadmissible.
